faqQ1: How many rounds are in a match?
faqA1: 4 rounds in order: What do you know?, Auction, Buzzer and Comeback. Whoever has the most points at the end wins.
faqQ2: What are the rules of "What do you know?"
faqA2: Each player gives one answer per turn. 3 mistakes and you're out of the question. You get one PASS that unlocks after two mistakes, and you can't PASS twice in a row.
faqA3: A hidden player is revealed through 3 clues. Each of you has 100 million: on your turn either raise by a million or say "take it" so your opponent gets him at that price and you get the other player in the same position for free. You build a five (keeper, defender, 2 midfielders, forward) and a coach, then the AI plays a match between you based on the players' ratings.
faqQ4: What if my connection drops mid-match?
faqA4: You have 30 seconds to come back. If you don't, it counts as a forfeit and your opponent wins.
faqA5: Every match gives you XP based on your result: wins give more, with bonuses for streaks and quick answers.
faqA6: The weekly ranking resets every Friday at midnight. Your overall level never resets.
faqQ7: How do I change my name or photo?
faqA7: From "Account" open "Profile", edit what you want and tap "Save changes".
faqQ8: How do I delete my account?
faqA8: Send a request from "Complaints & suggestions" and choose "Account". The account is deleted within 7 days.
faqQ9: A correct answer was marked wrong?
faqA9: Send it from "Complaints" and choose "Wrong question or answer". If you were right, we give you the points back.
faqQ10: A player is cheating or abusive?
faqA10: Report them from "Complaints" and choose "Abusive player". We review every report.
